title: Protect your primary inbox from spam: a layered defense
excerpt: Spam is the downstream effect of address exposure. Learn how addresses leak and how to layer short-lived inboxes, aliases, and a guarded primary address.
meta_title: Protect your primary inbox from spam
meta_description: How email addresses leak through signups, breaches, and scrapers — and how to layer short-lived inboxes, aliases, and smart unsubscribing against spam.
